payload.name: Interactive Multimedia Effectiveness
payload.fact: Interactive multimedia has a positive effect on student learning outcomes, with specific formats like Articulate Storyline and Augmented Reality-based E-Magazines showing high effect sizes.
payload.boundary: Effectiveness is measured by effect size calculations in high school biology contexts.

provenance.title: Pengaruh Multimedia Interaktif terhadap Hasil Belajar Siswa pada Materi Sistem Pencernaan
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results indicate that the use of interactive multimedia generally has a positive effect on student learning outcomes, with most media falling into the high to very high effect size category
